profile_text: With a focus on property development, management, and consulting, this Düsseldorf-based firm has experienced rapid expansion, growing its workforce by 266.7% since its baseline. As a specialist in real estate services, it has successfully capitalized on the demand for expert guidance in the German property market, driving its growth. With 66 employees as of 2024, the company continues to scale its operations, solidifying its position in the industry.
